svg.title: Arthur — system architecture
svg.desc: Browser UI over an Express server that owns ingest, retrieval, context building and inference, backed by one SQLite file and a local Ollama server.

svg.text: Every box above runs on one machine. The only network call Arthur ever makes is pulling a model.
